Q3.nonAdmittingSuccessor: admitRuntimeThreshold opens admitRuntimeEventTransactionAtDurablePrefix at the old predecessor and uses selectActiveRuntimeTransactionHistoryAtDurablePrefix with durableOnly:true. The shared scope-window flush must be durable before the decision projection. If the flush advances the durable prefix but the decision is runtime_threshold_not_reached, return and adopt the actual successor even though no threshold event is emitted; actor_process local successorPrefix must not remain stale. Merely staging the window in transaction-local state is insufficient.
